notes.title: Achievements and Game update
notes.notes:
[h3]Preface[/h3]

Good day to you all.  

As i promise i update this game but also i decided update achievements because I understand that the DMCA was extremely unpleasant news for you, as well as for me. 

This news will be divided into 3 parts.

1) Briefly about all changes.
2) Detailed update information with examples (achievements  only)
3) Answers to questions you might have.

I hope you will like this update, as I spent a lot of time to make it. I am also waiting for your opinion about this update, it is really important to me. 

                                      [i]Thank you for your attention and have a good game [/i]

[h2]Short information about update [/h2]
[list]

[u][b]About game[/b][/u]

[*] Completely changed level 21
[*] Changed title (Hope this is for last time)
[*] Added exit button
[*]Added Library Hero image (Appears at the top of a user's library details page for this product)
[*]Added Library Capsule image (This image is primarily used in the library overview and collection views)
[*]Added Library Logo image (Appears at the top of a user's library details page for this product, placed on top of the hero graphic)
[*] Changed size of icons (pause, mute, start, exit button etc)
[*] Slightly changed level 12
[*] Slightly changed font (to look like more beautiful)
[*] Slightly changed location of inscriptions (continue, levels etc)
[*] Fixed small problems with textures in level 5, 6, 10, 11, 15, 16, 18 and 19
[*] Fixed cloud speed (slower than before to look like more beautiful and not distract player)
[*] Fixed borders when game is paused
[*] Fixed score panel 



[u][b]About achievements[/b] [/u]

[*] Changed first and last achievement for something new
[*] Changed all 98 achievements for:
Achievements consisting of 7 pictures
Achievements consisting of 14 pictures
Achievements consisting of 21 pictures
[*] Removed all community achievements and wont add it before time is come

[/list]

[h2]FAQ:[/h2]

[*][b]What happened with community achievements?[/b]

[i]I have changed all achievements that was added or removed cause dmca or not added yet and I closed community achievements thread for this game until time is come[/i]

[*][b]Why did you changed all community achievements?[/b]

[i] As I see a very few people want their achievements in this type game (restricted one) So I have decided to do overall style for all achievements [/i]

[*][b]What does it mean "time is come" ?[/b]

[i] if restrictions from my game will be lifted (I hope) I will open community achievements thread again [/i]

[*][b]But we still cant put this achievements in our steam profile why did you do that?[/b]

[i] Same answer as before if restrictions from my game will be lifted (I hope) you can put already exists achievements in profile or order your own.[/i]

[*][b]Are you going to do same update for your other games ?[/b]

[i]Yes, more and better than this one[/i]

[*][b]Did you add new achievements?[/b]

[i]Nope, I have changed old one[/i]

[*][b]Should I unlock new achievements?[/b]

[i]Nope, If you have unlocked them before[/i]

[*][b]Can i still have community achievements?[/b]

[i]Yes you can [u][b]but[/b][/u] only in this game (Sky jump, Reflex, Mouse (Sneaking) Achievements printer, Blonde driver and Hentai 3018)[/i]

[*] [b]I still have a questions. What can i do ?[/b]

[i]Please reply in comments here and I will try to answer as soon as possible[/i]


[/olist]

notes.notes:

Thats why I have to remove ALL dmca achievements and i dont know what can i say..... 

Im just a fool who gave you achievements and now take it away 

Little faq 

Q: My achievements was removed can get new one without DMCA ?

A; Yes of course

Q; Why should i trust you now and why you wont remove it again ?

A: If achievements dont have any DMCA problem I wont remove it

Q; My achievements didnt have DMCA problem but you have removed them can i get it back ?

A: Yes you can if you give any proof its your picture and you have right for it

Q: How long does it take to remove achievements ?

A: Hope i can do it in 2 weeks

Q; Only this game ?

A; No I have to remove all dmca achievement in all my games

Q: Why did you close thread with comunity achievements ?

A: Because I need time to remove all DMCA achievements and when i done I open it again

Q; Why you dont care about DMCA earlier?

A: Seriously I didnt know that achievements can be a problem and my game can be removed cause of them. 

Q; Are you a fool and you dont care about your customers ?

A: Yes Im a fool but I care about my customers  and really think I did something good when i  had added  achievements but I didnt think about DMCA and It was my bad 


That is all If you have any question you can leave it here and sorry again....

Ps i won't do 2 posts as i did before
